rows.TEXT: King's Guard"Hail! We pray that we find you more friendly that the malicious Centaurs that we found to the North!"

Forest Elf"Our Centaurs were spellbound. A winged wizard flew through our settlement one day last fall, the centaurs took flight after him. We didn't see them again - until now. They have returned, in a dazed state, with no memory of their enslavement."
King's Guard"We found the Wizard, he is no more... Your people are safe from him henceforth. But there are Bigger enemies afoot! Horrible dragons have been wakened by the call of the warring Gods!"
Elf Lord"I have heard of your brave encounter with the Mage Hugin. Our Centaur fellows have been freed by your bravery! Accept this... it will protect your warriors."
Elf Lord"Farewell! Follow the path, it will lead you to your destination..."
Hel"Halt! Now listen! You have a great task before you. What are your plans?"
Hel"If you wish to let fly the magic of the Dwarves; And overpower the foe this way - step onto the southernmost island, there."
Hel"If you wish to crush the Wyrm with the warrior might; the might that the Gods gave the Clans - step onto the Northernmost island, there."
Hel"If you wish to lend Wotan your strength; to defend against the darkness hovering over our realm - step onto the middle island, here."
Dwarf Champion"Wotan requires our aid, he told us himself! Why must we prove our devotion?"
Hel"It is my nature to make riddles, that is all. There are other ancestors who can be awakened to help Wotan. Go to them, they are... here."
Alchemist"There is no earthly might which can defeat the Wyrm, we MUST use magic!"
Hel"Very well, I will grant you some spells which you may find useful against the menace. But I must warn you, do not neglect your duty to Wotan!"
Hel"There are other ancestors who can be awakened to help Wotan. Go to them, they are... here."
Veteran"Thank you, Hel. I remember hearing of your great deeds as a youngster. You were one of the fiercest warriors of the 5th age... we will spread the tales of your greatness once more!"
King's Guard"Yes, we must face this menace - the Dwarves are not known for their cowardice, after all! But why do you test us so?"
Hel"It is inadvisable to take such an attitude. There are other responsibilities... But, no matter, the choice has been made! Still, I can help you. Take this armor!"
Hel"There are other ancestors who can be awakened to help Wotan. Go to them, they are... here."

Hermit"You know what ravages the lands beyond this mountain range, do you not? It is Ragnarok, my friends! I saw it in a vision. But, no one has sought my wisdom since the Great Wars."
Loremaster"What is he talking of? The Ragnarok? That means that the Gods are at War! I have not foreseen this..."

Gefjon"So you have come at last... I needed you to help me break this horrible torpor! Ah! Wotan is calling! Before I depart I must thank you. This is the Tome of Arcanum, read it to learn new magical skills."
Rigga"Thank you, my Clansfellows! Wotan awaits my help, but the end of this Ragnarok is near. Our side is gaining ground! Wotan wishes me to give you this - to aid in the fight here in the realm."

Yataa'Halli"King's Guards! Gather your forces together. We have received refugees from all of our mountain cities... all except Ironhill! Discover how they have fared, for they may be in Danger."
King's Guard"Yes, at once! Ironhill is South of here, I will put together a company..."
Yataa'Halli"Beware, the mountains are very active, angry volcanoes and shifting rock will be your most feared enemy... It is easy to get lost in the changing landscape."
Yataa'Halli"I wonder what is causing the disturbances in the earth? This rocky land has always been our faithful home."
Loremaster"What is this monster! Back to Yataa'Halli - Ironhill is not safe! The city is nothing but burning rubble!"

Valkyrie"This spell will hold the Wyrm for now! But listen! A million of your Dwarves could not slay the Wyrm. It is The Ragnarok, my Dwarves - The Gods are battling above the skies of your realm! I must return soon to fight..."
Loremaster"Oh! Our Lord Wotan! We beg you! Use your powers - stop this turmoil, Please we nee-"

Valkyrie"Patience! Remember that his powers have grown weak. Maleficent beings are no longer on the sidelines of power, they have chosen this time to come forth from the shadows. This Wyrm is an emissary of evil!"

Valkyrie"You must correct this imbalance! Worship at the shrine of Hel, it is South of here - this will replenish some of Wotan's strength. Allow him to help you this way my children, Have Courage! Now - leave this place!"

Messenger"We hear that the Elves have preserved a Dwarven treasure. Their settlement can be found in the Southwest."
Man at Arms"Riddendorf boasts the finest warriors in the realm! I myself first saw battle at the age of 14. Not every race is so fierce!"
Dwarf"Ugh! These quarters are not worth our time, let's leave."

Dwarf 
"But wait! Here is an elixir which may help us. Will you examine it, Loremaster, to identify its usefulness?"
Loremaster"Oh, This is most certainly the King's palace. There are riches of all description!"
Dwarf"There is a fully stocked armory here! Look at this marvelous item. It has the most dreadful engravings around its circumference! I wonder what properties it holds?"
Loremaster"Enough, Let us keep to the task at hand. The Wyrm is here!"
King's Guard"Let's heal our armies before heading out."
Loremaster"How can we worry about the Greenskins when the Ragnarok is upon us?"
Dwarf"Nothing of any use here - the Primitives!"

Alvus"Aaarhgh! I awaken!!! It has been an eternity since Dwarves have approached my shrine. I feared that I had been forgotten! I haven't much time, I must battle above. Know that you have helped your kind by this seemingly small action. Take this."

Loremaster"Alvus is a most experienced warrior, or was, rather. As a mere boy he stopped 100 Imps single-handedly in the Clan Fortress. After his death, warriors prayed to him before battling demons; he was an important ancestor, and much honored."

King's Guard"It's no good, the Wyrm is still too strong for us! The Wyrm vanquishes the Ironhill armies without any trouble. They haven't even wounded the Wyrm at all! If we only had more armies so we could swarm the beast!"
Loremaster"Well, let us try what the Valkyries suggested. It is not too far to the shrine... It may be our only chance!"

In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in her times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended her reign of terror. She is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to her will.
